name: ui-engineering
description: Skills for analyzing, evaluating, documenting, testing, and improving user interfaces, interaction behavior, product flows, reactive code quality, evergreen UI documentation, and UX implementation details

interface.shortDescription: Analyze, test, and improve UI behavior and code
interface.longDescription: Skills for understanding user interfaces as product systems: evaluating UI/UX satisfaction, mapping screens, behaviors, interaction states, feature flows, user stories, edge cases, documentation-ready diagrams, evergreen screenshots and videos generated by backend-free workflow tests, backend-free UI testability through service boundaries and fakes, and reactive UI code quality with precise updates and cohesive files.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this app's UI behavior and document the user flows.
Make these UI flows testable without a backend.
Improve this UI code so reactivity is precise and files have clear responsibilities.
Generate evergreen UI documentation artifacts from backend-free workflow tests.
